infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PICK maps your cleanup route and marks which streets you've cleaned. Location is only tracked during an active cleanup session.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allowing background location lets PICK keep tracking your cleanup with the phone in your pocket and the screen off. Location is only used during active cleanup sessions.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: PICK uses motion sensors to automatically detect when you pick up trash, so you never have to press a button mid-cleanup.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PICK reads nothing from Health — this permission accompanies workout writing.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PICK logs each cleanup as a walking workout so your trash pickup counts toward your activity rings and exercise minutes.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PICK lets you snap a photo of the spot you cleaned up to share your impact.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PICK lets you attach a photo from your library to share your cleanup impact.
